Bug_Title: INT: Bad comparison of signed byte (INT_BAD_COMPARISON_WITH_SIGNED_BYTE)
Bug_Details:
Signed bytes can only have a value in the range -128 to 127. Comparing
a signed byte with a value outside that range is vacuous and likely to be incorrect.
To convert a signed byte b to an unsigned value in the range 0..255,
use 0xff & b.
 b 0xff & b
Bug_Explanation: The bug is embedded in the'showBug' method. A signed byte 'b' is compared with an integer value '127'. Since a signed byte can only have a value in the range -128 to 127, comparing 'b' with '127' is vacuous and likely to lead to incorrect results.
